securityInvariant.summary: XLSX and HWP exports must fail closed before expensive document generation when request bytes, document count, row count, nested entries, field characters, rendered cell estimate, or output bytes exceed bounded budgets.
securityInvariant.attackerControlledInput: POST JSON bodies to /api/export/xlsx and /api/export/hwp, including mode, rows, documents, structured data, risk rows, scenario, profile, and long string fields.
securityInvariant.legitimateBehaviorPreserved: Valid single XLSX, workpack XLSX, structured XLSX, and HWP exports continue to return bounded binary documents with no DB, Share, provider, vector, wiki, or registry mutation.

implementation.strategy: Shared route-level budget helper reused by XLSX and HWP.
